title: Carry the exact open-obligation count on every live obligation page and receipt
outcome: Carry the exact open-obligation count on every live obligation page and receipt
acceptance: A live obligation page for an item with no run carries open_total 0, so an absent open_total only ever means a page stored before the count existed, as the docs say
Tests cover both; the full quality gates pass
The mutation receipt's obligations.open reports the exact open count (open_total), not only the open items shown

completion.summary: Every live obligation page carries its exact open count. An item with no run (for example, one restored from a work-graph snapshot and not yet claimed) gets open_total 0, so an absent count only marks a page stored before the count existed. The mutation receipt's obligations.open reports open_total, falling back to the shown open items only for such a stored page. Landed as e996602 (installed in build a4c0b90d94ef) plus 823e61c. The second commit adds the regression test the first evaluation found missing: a restored item's revise and note results report open_total 0, and the test fails without the fix. The re-evaluation passed all three criteria.
